releaseNotes: Prevent Duplicate Locations on Map Edit: Fixed location updating so dragging or adjusting coordinates on the interactive map directly updates existing records via PATCH without spawning duplicate entries
Database Location Deduplication: Cleaned up duplicate locations so Field MRs have strictly their legitimate marked locations
Backend Location Role Permissions: Enabled MR role authorization for location updates

Unified MR Location Attribution: Resolved dashboard-mobile attribution conflict so Kotma locations correctly reflect Field MR discovery by Amar Dwivedi with route circuits across all admin and mobile views
Strict MR Location Isolation: Field Representatives strictly only view and manage locations and doctors marked by or assigned to them in the mobile directory and maps
Route Batch Circuit Selector on Map: Field Representatives can directly select and link a route batch circuit when marking or updating any facility location
Doctor Directory Route Circuit Badges: Doctor & facility directory displays assigned travel circuits with one-tap batch assignment
